stem: What is the significance of the Pilgrims' arrival in America?

options.label: A
options.text: It led to an alliance between the British and the French.

options.label: B
options.text: It led to an early attempt at self-government in the English colonies.

options.label: C
options.text: It caused Puritans to separate from the Church of England.

options.label: D
options.text: It introduced the slave trade to the Atlantic colonies.
